news.title: Abans Financial Services Limited Announces Resignation of Nirbhay Fancy Vassa as Chief Financial Officer Effective May 15, 2026
news.body: The board of directors of Abans Financial Services Limited meeting held on April 13, 2026, announced that Mr. Nirbhay Fancy Vassa has tendered his resignation from the position of Chief Financial Officer of the Company vide his resignation letter dated April 13, 2026, and his last working day shall be close of business hours of May 15, 2026. This decision follows careful consideration and is driven by his intent to step back from his current responsibilities to focus on the next phase of his professional journey and personal priorities. The Board/Nomination, Remuneration & Compensation Committee shall appoint his successor within stipulated timeline and intimate the Stock Exchanges accordingly.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹6.78 (vs ₹5.36 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.78 (up from ₹5.36 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹65.0b (up 407% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹320.6m (up 24% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.5% (down from 2.0% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 22% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 2% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
